items.title: AI is driving a flood of crypto bug reports. Now it's helping sort them
items.summary: Bug bounty platform HackerOne said it's increasing its triage throughput with AI agents after a record quarter of reports in the third quarter.

items.title: Privacy coins face diverging fortunes as KuCoin moves to drop Monero
items.summary: As KuCoin joins exchanges dropping Monero ahead of new EU restrictions, Grayscale argues that Zcash's privacy design sets it apart.

items.title: Binance completes withdrawal recovery four weeks after $6.3B hack
items.summary: The announcement concludes a phased withdrawal recovery that began on Nov. 1, when Binance restored Bitcoin withdrawals following the record crypto theft.

items.title: Bitcoin Holds Above $60K as Death Cross Clouds Thanksgiving Recovery
items.summary: Bitcoin and major altcoins rose slightly on Thanksgiving, but a bearish death cross suggests crypto remains weaker than stocks.

items.title: Spain Lets Its Financial Intelligence Unit Freeze Crypto Accounts Without a Court Order
items.summary: Sepblac can now suspend crypto, bank and payment accounts for up to five working days, with courts deciding on any extension.

items.title: JPMorgan says bitcoin 'capitulation' signaled by Strategy's record-low NAV multiple
items.summary: JPMorgan analysts said Strategy's valuation relative to its bitcoin holdings has hit a record low, signaling bitcoin capitulation.

items.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs on track for worst month on record as bear market drags on
items.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs have already hit record monthly net outflows of $5.39 billion in November, with several trading days remaining.

items.title: Morpho's largest euro stablecoin vault is 13.8 million short of covering its biggest depositor's exit
items.summary: The Nov. 26 app snapshot showed a gap of about 13.77 million EURCV in a hypothetical full withdrawal.

items.title: Bitcoin's $60,000 recovery masks a growing threat that could push its price as low as $29,000
items.summary: Bitcoin recovered above $60,000 after slipping below that mark on Nov. 25, in a volatile week in which Bitcoin fell to around $55,000.

items.title: A tiny payment can expose the IP address behind a bitcoin wallet, developer finds
items.summary: A Bitcoin Core contributor found that the wallet's habit of resending stuck payments lets anyone link an address to the computer watching it, for under 35 cents.

items.title: Bitcoin's dormant supply rises, a behavior seen during previous bear-market bottoming phases
items.summary: More bitcoin is sitting untouched onchain as the price holds around $60,000, some 50% below its peak.

items.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody suffers data breach, exposing client information
items.summary: The breach exposed client and employee contact information at Standard Chartered's crypto custodian, which said no unauthorized transactions took place.
